text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy gets injured during<n>training, so I rush
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! C'mon, you're freakin' out<n>about nothing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this is no big deal! You<n>worry too
much!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don'tcha know how strong villains<n>are?! I don't
need any rest!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So hurry up and let me get back to<n>running!
choice_data_list: I need you to take it easy for now.
...As long as you promise not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way! Listen to what your boss is<n>saying already!
choice_data_list: Not happening. You're too important to me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where's this comin' from, all<n>of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I guess this is just proof of<n>your loyalty as
my lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...And if I rest, you'll be happy?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Then I gotta do what I gotta<n>do. Takin' a
break now and then<n>can't be so bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy concedes to my wishes<n>and takes it
easy while she recovers.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: As if! I'mma do things Windy-style!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Time for a full-on sprint!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hah, ha—yeowch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Argh... Maybe I shouldn't have done<n>that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With tears pooling in her eyes, Shinko<n>Windy
expresses regret for her<n>actions. It seems getting
ample rest is<n>the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Told ya this injury was no<n>biggie!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh! Nope, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Stop looking at me all worried-like.<n>Let's get back to
our normal routine!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You should be grateful you're<n>trainin' an evil
genius like me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue training without putting<n>too much
burden on Shinko Windy's<n>injured area.
Thankfully, she's able<n>to recover right away.
